title: Bossclient
description: PVP Client for the best game experience
body:
👑 BossClient

Be the Boss in PvP.

BossClient is a performance-focused Minecraft client built entirely around competitive PvP. With 60+ modules across HUD, Combat, Movement, Render, and Misc, you get full control over how your game looks, feels, and performs — backed by a clean, modern interface and massive FPS gains.

Whether you're grinding practice servers, climbing ranked, or warming up in the Bedwars lobby, BossClient gives you the edge.



 ✨ Highlights

- ⚡ Huge performance — built-in FPS Booster pushes you well past **1700+ FPS**
- 🎯 18 customizable HUD elements — design your perfect overlay
- ⚔️ Clean, responsive combat feel with custom hit feedback
- 🎵 In-game Spotify integration — see and vibe to your music without alt-tabbing
- 🖱️ Raw Input for pixel-perfect, acceleration-free aim
- 🎨 Modern ClickGUI with live search and one-click toggles



 🎯 HUD Modules — Build Your Perfect Overlay

This is where BossClient shines. Every element is fully draggable and customizable through Edit HUD mode — position everything exactly where you want it.

- Spotify HUD — Displays your currently playing track right in-game: album cover, song title, and artist, complete with an animated audio visualizer. No more alt-tabbing to check what's playing.
- Mouse Tracker — A live visualization of your mouse movement that draws your aim path on screen. Perfect for analyzing your flicks, tracking, and aim consistency.
- Combo Counter — Shows your current hit combo so you can see exactly how many clean hits you land in a row.
- Reach Display — Shows your hit reach in blocks, so you always know your distance to the target.
- Totem HUD — Tracks your remaining totems at a glance — crucial for crystal and totem PvP.
- Entity Counter — Counts the entities around you, great for keeping tabs on crowded fights.
- Keystrokes & CPS — Live keystroke display (W A S D, LMB, RMB) and a clicks-per-second counter to monitor your input in real time.
- Looking At / Block Info / Biome / Server Info — Quick contextual info about what you're aiming at, the block in hand, your current biome, and server details.



 ⚔️ Combat Modules — Every Fight Feels Clean

- Hit Color — Tints entities a custom color when you hit them, so your strikes register visually and satisfyingly.
- Hit Sound — Plays a custom sound on every successful hit for instant audio feedback.
- Swing Speed — Adjusts your arm swing animation for a snappier, more responsive feel.
- Small Sword — Shrinks your held sword so it takes up less screen space and you keep full vision of your target.
- FOV Changer — Customize your field of view for better awareness and a wider look at the battlefield.



 🏃 Movement Modules — Smooth & Comfortable

- Auto Sprin — Keeps you sprinting automatically so you never lose momentum.
- Sprint Toggle / Sneak Toggle — Toggle sprinting and sneaking instead of holding keys down — easier on your hands during long sessions.
- Freecam — Detach your camera from your body to scout the area freely.



 ⚙️ Misc & Performance

- FPS Booster — Optimizes rendering for massive frame gains.
- Raw Input — Direct, unfiltered mouse input with zero acceleration for pixel-perfect aim.
- Zoom — Smooth zoom to spot enemies from a distance.
- Scoreboard Cleaner — Strips clutter from the server scoreboard for a cleaner screen.
- Cozy Menu — A relaxed, customizable menu theme.



 🎨 Clean, Modern Design

The intuitive ClickGUI features a live search bar, clear category tabs, and smooth toggle switches — finding and configuring any module takes seconds.

- Left-click to toggle a module
- Right-click (or `:`) for settings
- ESC to close



 📦 Version

Current release: 1.21.4



Take control. Build your HUD. Dominate the fight. 👑
